indexPrompt.cv-average-precision-and-nms: A line detector is scored on four 6 by 6 test images, each holding one line, with up to two predicted boxes per image. Compute average precision with and without non-maximum suppression at two IoU thresholds, then say when a teammate's two claims about duplicates and NMS each fail.
indexPrompt.cv-faint-lines-alone: A 6 by 6 image holds a bright vertical line that a PGD attack has dimmed while adding faint horizontal lines across rows 2 and 5. Try the faint lines on their own: add a to every pixel of rows 2 and 5, keep the line at 1, and find the vertical filter's pooled total at a = 0.4 plus the smallest a at which the network stops preferring vertical.
